label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button remains disabled after a failed export due to the `busy` state not being reset when `exportReport` rejects. The `handleClick` function only resets `busy` in the `.then()` callback, leaving it stuck if the fetch fails.

input.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export to allow retry
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `exportReport` function does not reset the `busy` state if the export fails (e.g., due to a server error). This causes the Export button to remain disabled until the page is reloaded. The fix is to wrap the `exportReport` call in a `try-catch` block and reset `busy` to `false` in the `catch` block, ensuring the button is re-enabled for retry.
